title: Weight of a bond made through the field

key_results.statement: Lowest one-object eigenvalue with point terms $g_a$ through third order, the Taylor expansion of the root of (4.15): $\varepsilon_0=-2Dt_f+\sum_a g_a/\mathcal X-\frac{1}{t_f\mathcal X}\sum g_ag_b\ell_{ab}+\frac{1}{t_f^2\mathcal X}[\sum g_ag_bg_c\ell_{ab}\ell_{bc}-\frac{\sum g_c}{\mathcal X}\sum g_ag_b\ell^{(2)}_{ab}]+O(g^4)$.

Exactly $\varepsilon_0=-2Dt_f+\delta$ with $\mathcal X\delta=e^Tg[1+R(\delta)g]^{-1}e$; for all $|g_a|\le t_f/(12\ell_0)$ it has exactly one root with $|\delta|\le t_f\omega_{\min}/2$, holomorphic in the couplings and, for real couplings, the non-degenerate lowest eigenvalue, uniformly in $L$, $D$ and the places.

Cauchy bound $|[g_1^ag_2^bg_s^j]\mathcal X\delta|\le6\rho^{1-a-b-j}$, $\rho=t_f/(12\ell_0)$; for $\eta\le1/24$ every truncation has an additive remainder with numerical constants independent of $L$, $D$ and the places; relative forms hold only where the stated quotients are small.

Bond profile $E(x_1,\mathbf r)-E(x_1,\mathbf r')=B(\mathbf r)-B(\mathbf r')+O(n|g_1g_2|\ell_0\eta/t_f)$, $B=-\frac{2ng_1g_2}{t_f}\ell(\mathbf r)$, relative remainder $O(\eta\ell_0/|\ell(\mathbf r)-\ell(\mathbf r')|)$; fixed by one total contract, as is $E$ itself; the profile alone leaves the zero of $B$ open, and the allocation into rest costs, own marks and bond is a convention.

Tori: $\ell(0)-\ell(\mathbf r)=\frac{\ln|\mathbf r|}{2\pi}+\frac{2\gamma_E+3\ln2}{4\pi}+O(|\mathbf r|^{-2})-\frac{|\mathbf r|^2}{4L^2}$ ($D=2$), $=G_0-\frac{1}{4\pi|\mathbf r|}+O(|\mathbf r|^{-3})-\frac{|\mathbf r|^2}{6L^3}$ with $G_0=0.2527310$ ($D=3$).

Weight of one body: $W_i=ng_i\phi+\frac{ng_sg_i^2}{t_f^2}[2\ell_0\ell+\ell^2-\frac{2}{\mathcal X}\ell^{(2)}](x-x_s)+O(n|g_s|\eta_i^3)$, $\phi=-\frac{2g_s}{t_f}\ell(x-x_s)$, on all three graphs, up to a place-independent constant; relative to place differences $O(\eta_i^2\ell_0/|\Delta\ell|)$.

Weight of the pair $W_1(x_1)+W_2(x_2)+W_b$ with $W_b=\frac{2ng_sg_1g_2}{t_f^2}[\ell(\mathbf r)(\ell_{1s}+\ell_{2s})+\ell_{1s}\ell_{2s}-\frac{\ell^{(2)}_{1s}+\ell^{(2)}_{2s}}{\mathcal X}]+O(n|g_sg_1g_2|\ell_0^2\eta/t_f^2)$.

$W_b=\frac12B(\mathbf r)[\phi(x_1)+\phi(x_2)]+\frac{ng_1g_2}{2g_s}\phi(x_1)\phi(x_2)$ minus a normalization term: the bond is weighed by the same $\phi$ as the first-order costs of the bodies, half at each body.

Exact rearrangement: $W_{\rm pair}=\mathcal C_{\rm p}(\mathbf r)\phi(x_1)+\frac{ng_s(g_1+g_2)^2}{t_f^2}[\ell(\mathbf R)^2-\frac{2\ell^{(2)}(\mathbf R)}{\mathcal X}]$ plus terms of first order in $\mathbf r\cdot\nabla\ell(\mathbf R)$; for $|\mathbf r|\ll d$ the coupling-made cost of the pair, bond included, is weighed by $\phi$.

Single body: level differences of weight equal level differences of cost times $F_i$ up to a relative $\epsilon_F=O(\eta(1+|\Delta\ell^{(2)}|/(\mathcal X\ell_0|\Delta\ell|))+\eta^2\ell_0/|\Delta\ell|)$, with $F_i=\phi$ (full grip, the same for all levels, branches and bodies) and $F_i=\frac{n\gamma_i}{1+n\gamma_i}\phi$ (coupling (a)).

Full grip: the exact ratio of the bond's weight profile to bond profile times $F$ is $\rho_0+O(\eta K)$ for $\ell(\mathbf r)\ne\ell(\mathbf r')$, $\Delta_{\mathbf e}\ell(\mathbf R)\ne0$, $\eta K\ll1$ (also where $\rho_0=0$), with $\rho_0=1+\kappa$ depending only on graph and places, not on levels, branches, $\gamma_i$, $N_f$, $t_f$ or the sign of the bond.

For $|\mathbf r|,|\mathbf r'|\ll d\ll L$, $\kappa$ is of first order in $\mathbf r/d$: $O(|\mathbf r'|/d)$ on the cubic torus, $O(\frac{|\mathbf r-\mathbf r'|}{d}\ln\frac{L^2}{|\mathbf r|d})$ on the square torus; it consists of the relocation of the midpoint at which the bond is weighed.

With the midpoint as the natural place: $\kappa^{\rm mid}=O(|\mathbf r||\mathbf r'|/d^2)$ (cubic), $O(\frac{|\mathbf r'|^2}{d^2}\ln\frac{L^2}{|\mathbf r'|d})$ (square), and $0$ on the ring at leading order in $\eta$; on the ring with place $x_1$, $\rho_0=\frac{2(1-w)(1-2w)}{(1-2u)(1-2v)}$ with $u=(d_1+\frac12)/L$, $v=(r-\frac12)/L$, $w=u+v$; full grip: the bond is weighed like the costs (yes on the ring and cubic torus, on the square torus only for $d$ large against $|\mathbf r|$ times a logarithm of $L$, and no at fixed generic places as $L\to\infty$ by (4.17)), exact ratios within $O(\eta K)$.

Coupling (a): the ratio is $\frac{1+n\gamma_i}{n\gamma_i}$ times the full-grip ratio times $1-\epsilon_C/[(1+n\gamma_i)(1+\epsilon_C)]$, $|\epsilon_C|\le c_*\eta$, i.e. $1+O(\eta)$ uniformly in $n$, $\gamma_i$, $L$, $D$ and the places, so wherever the full-grip ratio is 1 it is $>1$ on every graph: the bond is weighed more strongly than the level costs of the bodies.

Highest state (even $L$): exactly $\rho_i^{\max}(\sigma)=\rho_i^{\min}(-\sigma)$ and $\rho_i^{\rm mid,\max}(\sigma)=\rho_i^{\rm mid,\min}(-\sigma)$ for both couplings (all branches reversed, $\gamma_i$ fixed); at leading order $B$, $\phi$, $F_i$ change sign, $W_b$ does not, and $\rho_0$, $\rho_0^{\rm mid}$, $\frac{1+n\gamma_i}{n\gamma_i}$ are unchanged; at the same branches the part of an exact ratio odd in the couplings, including its first correction, reverses sign.

Square torus at fixed places: $\rho_0=\beta_L\ell_0+\rho_L$ (likewise $\rho_0^{\rm mid}$) with $\beta_L,\rho_L$ convergent and $\ell_0\simeq\frac{1}{2\pi}\ln L$; where $\beta=\lim\beta_L\ne0$ (code: $1.26$, $0.80$ at $x_1$, $-1.15$ at the midpoint), $K\asymp\ell_0^3$, and along $\gamma_i\propto\ell_0^{-5}$, $|g_s|\le t_f/(24\ell_0)$, $\eta K=O(1/\ell_0)\to0$ and the exact full-grip ratios diverge (control); at fixed couplings only the leading coefficient fails.

open_issues: Separations are those of field places; their relation to the distances of 03-ilang-space is not used.

The ratio depends on the place assigned to an extended pair (x1, the question's place, against the midpoint, the natural place); which place the fall of a pair tests is for the packages on mutual motion and inertia.
The O(η) dependence of the ratio on levels, branches and bodies is shown numerically only.

Apart from the cost differences of a body alone (ε_C, used in (4.13)), remainders are uniform in L, D and the places only in additive form; the derived relative constants (e.g. K) grow with d and L, while the code finds much smaller deviations without that growth; a derivation of the sharper relative control is open.

The torus estimates of κ and κ_mid are order estimates at generic places, checked numerically; they fail where the gradient of ℓ along the step vanishes; likewise β ≠ 0 in (4.17) is shown only at the tested places.
Only held bodies and the lowest (or mirrored highest) field state are treated.
For coupling (a) the rest term is not weighed at this order; whether a wider class weighs it is not decided here.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions of B, W_b, φ and the ratios
g_2 → 0 reduces the pair to body 1; on the cubic torus W_b vanishes as all separations grow (code: decay as L^-2)
Hellmann–Feynman sum rule: the g_1 g_2 part of the weight sums to zero over the place (analytic; code ≤ 1e-15)
